report: Decreased right-eye acuity (20/80) with an elevated white-greyish macular lesion, vascular distortion and traction indicated a macular tractional lesion (node-5). OCT showing an epiretinal membrane, disorganized retinal layers and a hyperreflective mass, plus FA tortuosity/leakage, support this mechanism, and the radiologist explicitly favored epiretinal-membrane-induced traction (0.85). No vitreous attachment or detachment argues against VMT/tractional detachment, and amblyopia is refuted.
